title: Manage Zsh config without publishing API credentials
description: Why: ~/.zshrc contains useful public shell configuration alongside private API credentials, while this repository is public. What: add a GNU Stow zsh package, move credential exports to a private mode-0600 file outside Git, add a safe example, and verify no secret values enter the repository.
acceptance_criteria: The zsh package is stowable; ~/.zshrc loads a private secrets file; private values remain unchanged and absent from tracked files; syntax and permissions checks pass.

title: Fix Windows installer media device issue in windows-vm
description: Why: Windows setup is failing to start and appears to complain about a CD/DVD or media device during install. What: adjust the qemu launcher to attach installation media in a more compatible way and reduce install-time device friction for this Windows 10 VM.

title: Add windows-vm doctor and Windows 10 readiness checks
description: Why: the Windows VM launcher needs a preflight command to validate lightweight Windows 10 readiness on this machine before attempting downloads and install. What: add a doctor subcommand covering KVM/device access, groups, ISO paths, OVMF, swtpm, and free disk space, then verify it locally.

title: Add reusable Windows VM setup
description: Why: the dotfiles repo should capture a reproducible Windows VM launcher for this Fedora machine without committing VM images or ISOs. What: add a stowable package with a qemu launcher, example config, and minimal docs for first boot and subsequent starts.
